sections.Profile:
The "Niagara" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in December 1951, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. The machine features two flippers, four pop bumpers, six passive bumpers, two slingshots, and four trap holes.
